QuestInfo.name: Maple World's Idol
QuestInfo.0: Ask when you can receive the next power from Eskalade.
QuestInfo.1:
You met the condition to receive the next power, but Eskalade is burned out and unable to unlock it.
Defeat #b#o2230110##k that appears in #b#m102040000##k and get #bEssence Stone#k for Eskalade.
QuestInfo.2: Eskalade was re-energized after consuming the Essence Stone, and granted the new power.
